data.title: Install standalone Lux desktop app with branding and MCP
data.body: Install Lux as a self-contained Windows desktop app with Desktop and Start-menu shortcuts. Double-click runs the installed build without repository or globally installed Node. Include compiler, SDK, matching MCP adapter and automatic discovery/free local port. Add a coherent Lux app icon, favicon and logo. Preserve active sessions and user files. Verify installed launch and MCP discovery/read/build, branded UI screenshot, independent review, and installed skills.
data.summary: Installed the standalone Lux desktop app with Desktop and Start-menu shortcuts, branded executable/window/favicon, bundled Node/compiler/SDK/MCP, and installed-app discovery in start-lux. Final package built from committed source and activated after real application QA and independent review.
data.evidence: Source commit ca1bedb489e9f2531b0e0f63f7c2c96a4ba7ccd7. Final installed directory C:/Users/zFlei/AppData/Local/Programs/Lux/builds/ca1bedb4-236444c2. Evidence C:/Users/zFlei/repos/lux/.worktrees/_coordination/lux-desktop/: final-package.json (official Electron archive checksum and source input digest), app-qa.json (exact final installed app PID/profile/workspace; MCP discover/read/build/capture; invalid-edit preview preservation; favicon and disabled export menu), installed-window.png, installed-menu.png, installed-executable-icon.png, app.log. Delayed-ready test withheld renderer readiness for 4 seconds and confirmed no premature endpoint, then exact owner status. Test preload restored byte-for-byte; owned test processes exited. Focused package/discovery/closure/shortcut/page/session tests and TypeScript passed. Both shipped skills installed/current. Independent Sol high reviewer /root/review_desktop: source and UX pass after fresh final rebuild; that condition fulfilled. Terra medium /root/lux_brand produced vector/raster branding and verified Windows icon-resource replacement. Model/context choices bounded to packaging risk and asset work. Desktop and Start COM shortcut targets/icons verified; bundled Node --status reports installed and closed.
data.qa: Ready to double-click Lux. User creative/copilot processes and saved files preserved. Native Resolume export is not included; menu labels it unavailable and backend refuses it. Local app is unsigned. Automatic approval review blocked Remove-Item cleanup of two inactive package attempts with the generic reason blocked by policy; they were retained. No further installation work remains.
